floor.title: Floor
floor.emptyBody: Ask your admin to add the tables. They appear here as soon as they are added.
floor.emptyMineTitle: Every occupied table is somebody else's
floor.emptyMineBody: Turn off Mine to see the whole floor.

table.title: Table {{label}}
table.nothingSentBody: Add dishes above and send them as one ticket.

bill.nothingBody: Every dish on this table was cancelled or nothing was ordered, so no bill was made.

basket.title: Basket, not sent yet
basket.flagged_one: {{count}} dish in the basket has just gone off. Take it out to send the rest.
basket.flagged_other: {{count}} dishes in the basket have just gone off. Take them out to send the rest.
basket.noteTooLong: A note can be at most {{max}} characters.
basket.splitNamed: Put one {{dish}} on its own line
basket.discardedClosed: This table has closed, so the unsent basket was cleared.

orders.title: Orders
orders.emptyBody: Tables appear here as soon as somebody opens one on the floor.
orders.emptyMineTitle: None of your tables are open
orders.emptyMineBody: Turn off Mine to see every open table.

takeOver.done: This table is yours now. Its ready alerts come to you.

move.title: Move table {{label}}
move.description: The party takes its rounds, its bill, and anything in the basket with it.
move.noneFree: Every table is taken right now.
move.done: Moved. The kitchen sees the new table.

void.title: Cancel this dish?
void.description: {{quantity}} × {{dish}}. It comes off the bill and the kitchen stops cooking it.
void.detailsRequiredHint: Say what happened. Needed for Other.
void.reasonRequired: Say what happened, so a manager reading this later knows.
void.done: Dish cancelled. It is off the bill.
